full_judgment: 6. The learned Advocate for the petitioners submitted that the time taken for leave and Upazilla Court inspection should not have been excluded in computing the specified period of limitation for trial. He argued that the learned Sessions Judge might be on leave or absent for Upazilla Court inspection, but those days cannot be taken into account for extending the period of limitation prescribed u/s. 339-C of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
